(Lib Dem minority) }} '''Elections to [[Portsmouth City Council]]''' took place on Thursday 5 May 2022, alongside other [[2022 United Kingdom local elections|local elections]] across the country. The seats contested in this election were last contested in [[2018 Portsmouth City Council election|2018]]. The [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative Party]] had 6 seats they were defending, while the Liberal Democrats and Labour were both defending 4 seats. No party gained a majority from this election, and therefore the council remains under no overall control, with the Liberal Democrats continuing to run the council in a minority.{{cite web | url=https://www.portsmouthlabourparty.org.uk/portsmouth-labour-news/2022/05/20/labours-approach-to-running-the-council-in-the-coming-year/ | title=Labour's approach to running the council in the
